ABSENT per R5, with a BOUND. ROCKWOOL reports geography as four regions (Western Europe / Eastern Europe and Russia / North America / Asia and others) and never names the UK. The note states: 'In Germany, France, and the United States revenue amount to between 10-15 percent of the Group's total revenue ... In no other country does revenue exceed 10 percent.' Identical wording in FY2020, FY2021 and FY2024. BOUND WITH ITS DIRECTION: UK revenue is BELOW 10% of group, so the magnitude is bounded above by 0.7865 x 0.10 = 0.0786 at FY2024. Rockwool would be the second-largest exposure in the sample if the figure existed; it does not, in any vintage.
